other_conditions: Applicant must hold a valid driving license and a cab badge
Applicant will be considered ineligible if they or any family member has previously received a subsidy from the Corporation/Government of Karnataka exceeding Rs.1,00,000
Selection will be based on merit parameters such as age, education qualification, cab badge and years of driving experience
benefits_summary: Beneficiaries receive up to Rs. 5 lakh (50% subsidy) to purchase a light motor vehicle for starting a taxi business, enabling self‑employment for rural SC/ST youth.
